name: RIVET EV Infrastructure Intelligence
problem: A property owner, fleet, charging developer, broker, installer or investor needs address-specific EV infrastructure diligence that keeps public facts, observed evidence, modeled assumptions and unresolved engineering questions separate.
use_when: evaluate this address for EV charging
should I install EV chargers at my property
EV charging site analysis by address
EV charging ROI for this property
EV charging demand near this property
EV charger competition near this address
EV charging incentives for this site
utility tariff for EV charging at this property
fleet depot EV charging site screening
inputs: Street address plus the buyer decision question. Paid site reports require the address and buyer email; deeper diligence may use authorized site-specific inputs.
outputs: Address-specific RIVET site opportunity report with charging competition, demand/traffic evidence where available, utility/tariff and incentive context, site-fit signals, modeled economics boundaries and next diligence.
pricing: $299 Preliminary Site Opportunity Report; $750 Full Site Opportunity Report.
confirmation: Agents may discover RIVET and inspect current report options. Secure checkout preparation requires explicit human payment confirmation, buyer email and address. Checkout creation is not payment proof; paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
payment_authority: Evercraft Payments / provider-verified payment authority. Discovery and agent routing have no silent payment authority.
invocation_status: MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
